newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria buys 75,000 T French Coface wheat.
newsitem.headline: Algeria buys 75,000 T French Coface wheat.

text.p: Algeria bought 75,000 tonnes of French soft wheat for April delivery onwards under a Coface export credit at about $165 per tonne, including cost and freight, European grain exporters said.
Exporters said talks were still going on for the purchase of two additional cargoes.
"They did three cargoes under Coface. There may be two additional cargoes for cash payment. But we don't know yet," one exporter said.
On February 17 Algeria launched a tender for the import of 125,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat for shipment between April 1 and June 15.
